name: zadarma-mcp
description: Zadarma cloud telephony: PBX, voice menus (IVR), SIP, virtual numbers, SMS, statistics and Teamsale CRM, from Claude.
long_description: Unofficial connector for the Zadarma API (regular account). 26 tools, one per API section, each with an `action` parameter: account info, callback, SIP numbers, price plan, statistics, PBX settings, extensions, external lines, call recordings, hold music, IVR sounds, menus and scenarios, speech recognition, virtual numbers, SMS, WebRTC widget, eSIM, Verify and the Teamsale CRM. Actions that spend money, cannot be undone or reach other people run only with confirm: true, after the user approves; without it the tool returns what it would do and changes nothing. Requests, including the parameters and any uploaded audio file, are sent to Zadarma (api.zadarma.com). You need your own Zadarma API key and secret.

tools.name: zadarma_info
tools.description: Account information: balance, call price, timezone, currencies, languages, price plans; number verification call; number lookup (HLR).

tools.name: zadarma_callback
tools.description: Start a callback: Zadarma first calls `from` (your phone, SIP, extension or PBX scenario), then connects it to `to`.

tools.name: zadarma_sip
tools.description: SIP numbers of the account: list, online status, Caller ID, call forwarding, create, password.

tools.name: zadarma_tariff
tools.description: Current price plan and changing it. See zadarma_info action tariffs for the list of plans.

tools.name: zadarma_statistics
tools.description: Call statistics. Zadarma allows only 3 statistics requests per minute; do not poll. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

tools.name: zadarma_pbx
tools.description: PBX settings: create the PBX, call forwarding on an extension, call-info (NOTIFY_*) and other webhook URLs. Receiving webhooks is not part of this tool; it only sets where Zadarma sends them.

tools.name: zadarma_pbx_extensions
tools.description: PBX extensions (e.g. 100): list, online status, details, call recording, create, passwords, supervisor mode, Caller ID.

tools.name: zadarma_pbx_ext_lines
tools.description: External lines of the PBX (up to 20, one of them free): list, create, edit, delete. connection_type gateway = your device registers on Zadarma; server = Zadarma registers on your SIP server (then server, login and secret are required). Paths are /v1/pbx/ext_lines/* (unverified: the reference shows them without /v1).

tools.name: zadarma_pbx_records
tools.description: Call recordings: get a temporary download link, or delete recordings. Returns links only, never audio. Use call_id (one recording) or pbx_call_id (all recordings of a call) from the PBX statistics.

tools.name: zadarma_pbx_hold_music
tools.description: Hold music of the PBX (played instead of ringing): upload (MP3 or WAV, up to 5 MB, from a local path), switch, delete.

tools.name: zadarma_ivr_sounds
tools.description: Voice-menu (IVR) sound files: list, upload (MP3 or WAV, up to 5 MB, from a local path) and delete.

tools.name: zadarma_ivr_menus
tools.description: Voice menus (IVR) of the PBX: list (with status, type and working hours), create, delete. Menu 0 is the main menu.

tools.name: zadarma_ivr_scenarios
tools.description: Scenarios of a voice menu: what happens on a key press (or no press). push_button: -1 = no key pressed, 0-9 = keys, 10 = autoresponder, 11-30 = additional scenarios. A scenario rings extensions or phone numbers (space-separated) or "fax".

tools.name: zadarma_speech_recognition
tools.description: Speech recognition of PBX call recordings: get the result, or start recognition (manual recognition must be enabled on the extension).

tools.name: zadarma_numbers
tools.description: Virtual (direct) numbers: list and details, auto-renewal, Caller name, routing to a SIP, ordering and prolonging, SMS reception, incoming channels. Ordering needs a documents group, which is created in the Zadarma web account.

tools.name: zadarma_sms
tools.description: Send SMS, list SMS templates, and list allowed senders for a number.

tools.name: zadarma_webrtc
tools.description: WebRTC web-phone widget: key for a SIP or extension, create/show/change/delete the integration, allowed domains.

tools.name: zadarma_esim
tools.description: eSIM data packages: supported devices, available packages, connected packages, order a package.

tools.name: zadarma_verify
tools.description: Send a verification code by SMS, call or email (or a press-1 call), and check the code. A request is valid for 10 minutes.

tools.name: zadarma_crm_customers
tools.description: Teamsale CRM customers (clients) and their source tags, labels, custom properties, timeline notes and employees.

tools.name: zadarma_crm_leads
tools.description: Teamsale CRM leads: list, get, create, update (and convert to a client), delete.

tools.name: zadarma_crm_users
tools.description: Teamsale CRM users (your team): list, one user, working hours, groups and rights.

tools.name: zadarma_crm_contacts
tools.description: All CRM contacts with phone numbers (clients, employees, leads, users): search, and identify a phone number.

tools.name: zadarma_crm_deals
tools.description: Teamsale CRM deals and their feed notes.

tools.name: zadarma_crm_tasks
tools.description: Teamsale CRM tasks and planned calls (events): list, get, create, update, close, delete.

tools.name: zadarma_crm_calls_files
tools.description: Teamsale CRM call list, and file information by ID (metadata only; file contents are never returned).

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your Zadarma API key (Zadarma account > Settings > API). Stored securely by the Claude desktop app.

api_secret.title: API secret
api_secret.description: Your Zadarma API secret (Zadarma account > Settings > API). Stored securely by the Claude desktop app.
